Package com.sandy.sconsole.ai

Record Class AttemptResult

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.sandy.sconsole.ai.AttemptResult
Record Components:
attempt - the attempt
elapsedMs - from sending to the end
outcome - how it ended
response - the raw reply, or the raw error body when the gateway sent one; null when there was nothing
failure - a short readable reason; null on success
kind - why it failed, for fallback; null on success
usage - the tokens it used; null if the gateway did not say
reasoning - the model's reasoning before it answered, when a reply came with one; null otherwise (an error body keeps any reasoning in response)
public record AttemptResult(Attempt attempt, long elapsedMs, AttemptResult.Outcome outcome, String response, String failure, FailureKind kind, TokenUsage usage, String reasoning) extends Record
How an Attempt ended.
